notes.title: UPDATE 1.4.0
notes.notes:
ːNAYUː Hello, adventurers.

I have added a few small features and added the Russian language.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank the team that helped me with the translation into Russian.
Thank you so much!

Russian Translation
　　RytmLower

 Resetting Game Data 

A function has been added to reset progress and achievement information.
A button has been added in the upper right corner of the settings screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39302015/049ff0d325a9f8b8112f3c8994043767c7fc2213.png

By pressing and holding this button, you can reset all data except for "Play Time" and "Star Shards.".
You will have to start from the beginning, but I believe that this will solve the problem of  not being able to release achievements .

I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and I hope you will give it a try.


Update Information 1.4.0

Fixes, Additions:
+ Add Russian to Languages.
　　Translation：RytmLower
+ Added icon to "Settings" item on title screen
+ Added a reset button for game data in the settings screen
+ Fixed data saving functionality

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Good day, everyone.

This is a very short game, but I am very honored that so many people have played it.
Thank you so much!

I would like to take this opportunity to thank Jennie González and 西寧王澤口 for their help in translating this patch.
Thank you so much!


Update Information 1.1.0
Fixes, changes：
+ Fixed a bug where the fullscreen flag was not being saved.
+ Fixed typos in some text.
+ Fixed a bug where sound mute information set during the game was not reflected in the settings panel.
+ Change the values required for achievements..
　　Title: "Thanks for playing!"
　　　　Before: 60 minutes
　　　　After: 45 minutes

Additions:
+ Added version notation to the title screen.
+ Added Nayu's personal clothes.
+ Added "Spanish (Spain)" as a language.
　　Translated by Jennie González (@zonzira)
+ Added "Chinese (Simplified)" as a language.
　　Translated by 西寧王澤口


Oh by the way, I'm making an offer to have Nayu and her friends perform in my next game...
